messages:
Jordan V: Heads-up — during a spot-check I found 5 scorecards attached without ratings for the Data Eng req. Candidates show interview completed but rating=null. Can someone triage? :thinking_face:

Ops Bot: Bulk import job 2026-12-15T15:00:00Z finished with warnings. missing_ratings=5. Job: https://ats.example/jobs/job_20261215_150000

Kelsey N: On it. Quick SQL to list suspects:
```sql
SELECT i.id, i.candidate_id, s.id AS scorecard_id, s.rating
FROM interviews i
LEFT JOIN scorecards s ON s.interview_id = i.id
WHERE i.req_id='REQ-2026-ENG-DATA' AND i.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND (s.rating IS NULL OR s.id IS NULL);
```
I'll run and paste CSV to the recruiters channel.

Ravi S: Likely causes: 1) template mismatch during import, 2) mobile app submissions lost rating field, or 3) CSV quoting issue. Short-term fix: reattach via API for the ones with attachments but missing rating. If rating truly missing we need interviewer follow-up.

Emily (People Ops): I'll open INT-5299 and tag recruiting. Action plan: (1) Kelsey to dump the list + raw payloads, (2) I will prepare a small reattach script that sets rating when provided, otherwise flag for manual follow-up, (3) add an hourly alert that fires when any completed interview has no rating, (4) schedule two 20-min calibration refreshers next week (Wed 11:00 UTC, Thu 19:00 UTC).

Jordan V: Please snapshot DB rows before any automatic patches so we can audit. Also prefer a soft rollout for the alert (warnings for 48h).

Kelsey N: Snapshot taken and uploaded to https://internal.redwood/snapshots/ops-1781234567. Pushed CSV to #recruiting (private).

Ravi S: I'll add the banner in candidate UI: "Scorecard missing: recruiter action required" and queue a frontend ticket. Also adding a short recruiter-only action to set rating if interviewer confirms via email.

Ops Bot: Ticket created: INT-5299 (ats-scorecard-missing) assigned to Emily (People Ops).

Emily (People Ops): Draft for the calibration invites: 1) quick rubric recap (5m) 2) 3 live examples (10m) 3) Q&A (5m). I'll post RSVP link & micro-quiz in #hiring-toolkit after INT-5299 is created. ETA reattach script: EOD today. Will post results here. :white_check_mark:
